script_text: Taurus, the cosmos just flipped a silent switch that will reshape your week. Early week, Mars squares Venus in your 2nd House of Income, creating Earth-element friction around money—avoid signing contracts Monday and Tuesday. By Wednesday, Jupiter trines your Sun in the 9th House, opening a door for growth. Mid-week turning point arrives when Mercury enters Leo and activates your 7th House of Partnerships, pulling love into focus. Late week, Saturn opposes your Moon in the 4th House of Home, stirring emotional turbulence Thursday and Friday. But weekend shifts as Venus enters your 5th House of Romance, sparking a passionate encounter. Wednesday is your power day because Jupiter trines your Sun in the 9th House. Thursday is your worst day because Saturn opposes your Moon in the 4th House. Protect your emotional boundaries by postponing home decisions until the weekend. Follow for daily updates.
